subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the newly pinned action revisions be approved for OpenClaw's secret-bearing token, release, scanning, and Codex workflows after the branch is refreshed and exact-head checks complete?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but CI cannot establish trust in newly executed third-party action code or decide whether the grouped security-sensitive upgrade scope is acceptable.

options.title: Verify and merge the refreshed group
options.body: Refresh onto current main, confirm the completed exact-head checks and upstream release changes, then merge the immutable-pin update as one batch.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, registry, release, and scanning actions into smaller PRs if maintainers want independent review and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge the refreshed group
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, confirm the completed exact-head checks and upstream release changes, then merge the immutable-pin update as one batch.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the Codex agent workflows, action-runtime modernization, and Docker release workflow affected by this grouped update.
